description: Set a custom thumbnail for a video. Send exactly one of imageUrl, imageBase64 or atSeconds. The image must be JPEG, PNG or WebP and at most 10 MB; the type is judged from the file bytes, not the name. atSeconds uses the video frame at that moment; this tool waits up to 60 seconds for the frame and returns its url, or says it is still processing (check later with get_media_status, which carries the thumbnail field). Each call replaces the current custom thumbnail, and there is no way back to the automatic one. Needs permission to edit the media. Errors: 400 bad input, unsupported image, blocked link or failed frame; 413 image too large; 409 a frame is already being made; 503 frame service busy, try again shortly.

atSeconds.description: Use the video frame at this many seconds from the start. Values past the end use the last second.

imageBase64.description: The image bytes in base64 (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB once decoded). A data:image/...;base64, prefix is allowed.

imageUrl.description: A public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 10 MB. The server downloads it.
